def factor_volume_weighted_momentum(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    vol_ratio = df_copy["volume"] / df_copy["volume"].rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
    weighted_ret = ret * vol_ratio
    sum_wt_ret = weighted_ret.rolling(10, min_periods=10).sum()
    sum_vol = vol_ratio.rolling(10, min_periods=10).sum()
    factor = sum_wt_ret / sum_vol.replace(0, np.nan)
    df_copy["factor_volume_weighted_momentum"] = factor.fillna(0)
    return df_copy["factor_volume_weighted_momentum"]
description: Captures price momentum weighted by volume coherence; when price moves up on high volume and down on low volume, the weighted average is positive, signaling sustainable trend. Cross-sectional z-scoring highlights stocks with strongest volume-confirmed momentum relative to peers.
